results.title: Former Kolkata Mayor Firhad Hakim praises Urban Development Minister Agnimitra Pal in Assembly
results.description: Former West Bengal Urban Development Minister and ex-Kolkata Mayor Firhad Hakim surprised the Assembly by praising current Urban Development Minister Agnimitra Pal for her proactive approach, while acknowledging shortcomings during his own government’s tenure.
